title: test_land_waits_hook_of_a_finished_session fails in a whole-suite run on a loaded host
goal: A whole-suite tests.py run passes on a loaded host, as the test does alone: observed 2026-10-11 in a 12-worker run that took 193 s, where test_land_e2e.TestHookWait.test_land_waits_hook_of_a_finished_session_then_removes_its_worktree_and_multirepo_land_cleans_per_repository saw 'land: waited 2s ... for a process whose parent had exited to end' where it expects 'for the session-end hook to end'; the same test alone passed in 18 s. The run also exceeded the darwin ceiling (193 s against 22 s), which load alone may explain.

gates.question: How long may the hook test's orphan wait for land's look before it ends on its own (the leak cap of orphan_in)?

notes: 2026-10-11/12 SP-wwacrsqr review: the review story's done re-ran the whole suite seven times. While a game held the CPU (load 4-12) it took 160-193 s and this test failed each time; the test alone passed in 16.8 s (tests.py -k test_land_waits_hook_of_a_finished_session). With the game gone, 100 passed in 22.5-23 s twice and 30 s once while Spotlight mds_stores and a query-log distill ran near 100% CPU each, refused only on the 22 s darwin ceiling: host contention, not a defect of the test or the sprint's content. Planned for SP-b7wibqok: the repro (whole suite) passes on a quiet host and fails only under load, so it proves nothing before the work; the check that fails now selects the renamed test. Cause: orphan_in (test_land_e2e.py:421) starts a process that sleeps a fixed 1 s, and on a loaded host the process has ended before land's look at its standard output (bl_procs.hook_pids), so no hook is seen and the message reads 'for a process whose parent had exited'. Fix in the test: the orphan stays until land has looked (a sentinel file the test creates), not a fixed sleep. The suite sits at max_ids 100: rename TestHookWait's test to carry the name the check selects, no new id; no code under _tools/bl_ changes. Plan-time runs (2026-10-12): the repro's first whole-suite run was refused at 27 s against the 24 s darwin ceiling while sibling planners ran, the retry passed in 23.1 s: the repro passes on a quiet host, so check 0 is the one that fails before the work.
